target_passage: Everyone has the right to life, liberty and the security of person. No one shall be held in slavery or servitude; slavery and the slave trade shall be prohibited in all their forms. No one shall be subjected to torture or to cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment. Everyone has the right to recognition everywhere as a person before the law. All are equal before the law and are entitled without any discrimination to equal protection of the law. All are entitled to equal protection against any discrimination in violation of this Declaration and against any incitement to such discrimination.

candidates.question: Who must provide an effective remedy for acts violating a person's fundamental rights?
Until what point is everyone charged with a penal offence presumed innocent?
candidates.answer_in_source: Until proved guilty according to law in a public trial.

candidates.question: Within what limits does everyone have freedom of movement and residence?
candidates.answer_in_source: Within the borders of each State.

candidates.question: Under what condition may a marriage be entered into?
candidates.answer_in_source: Only with the free and full consent of the intending spouses.

candidates.question: In what two ways does the text say property may be owned?
candidates.answer_in_source: Alone as well as in association with others.

candidates.question: In what capacity does everyone have the right to social security?
What must just and favourable remuneration ensure for a worker and his family?
candidates.answer_in_source: An existence worthy of human dignity.

candidates.question: What does the right to rest and leisure include?
candidates.answer_in_source: Reasonable limitation of working hours and periodic holidays with pay.

candidates.question: What kind of order is everyone entitled to so that the rights and freedoms of this Declaration can be fully realized?
Which three kinds of actors may not claim a right to destroy the rights set forth in this Declaration?
According to the text, which four things must no one suffer arbitrary interference with?
candidates.answer_in_source: His privacy, family, home or correspondence.

candidates.question: Within what limits does everyone have the right to freedom of movement and residence?
candidates.answer_in_source: Within the borders of each State.

candidates.question: Which limitations may not be placed on the right of men and women of full age to marry?
What shall be the basis of the authority of government?
What must just and favourable remuneration ensure for a worker and his family?
candidates.answer_in_source: An existence worthy of human dignity.

candidates.question: What are motherhood and childhood entitled to?
Why does everyone have duties to the community?
candidates.answer_in_source: Because the free and full development of his personality is possible in the community alone.

candidates.question: What kind of hearing is everyone entitled to in full equality?
Under which bodies of law must an act or omission have constituted a penal offence when it was committed?
In what cases may the right to asylum not be invoked?
candidates.answer_in_source: In the case of prosecutions genuinely arising from non‐political crimes or from acts contrary to the purposes and principles of the United Nations.

candidates.question: According to the text, what may a person not be denied the right to change?
What may no one be compelled to belong to?
Through what forms of effort is the realization of these rights to be achieved?
candidates.answer_in_source: Through national effort and international co‐operation.

candidates.question: What kind of pay is everyone entitled to without any discrimination?
What is the second situation listed in which everyone has the right to security?
Which just requirements may limitations on a person's rights be imposed to meet?
candidates.answer_in_source: Morality, public order and the general welfare in a democratic society.

candidates.question: How much of this Declaration may be interpreted as implying a right to destroy the rights it sets forth?
What is the last item listed as protected from arbitrary interference?
From what does everyone have the right to seek and to enjoy asylum in other countries?
What is required before a marriage may be entered into?
candidates.answer_in_source: The free and full consent of the intending spouses.

candidates.question: In what two ways may everyone take part in the government of his country?
candidates.answer_in_source: Directly or through freely chosen representatives.

candidates.question: What does the right to rest and leisure include?
candidates.answer_in_source: Reasonable limitation of working hours and periodic holidays with pay.

candidates.question: Besides unemployment and sickness, in what circumstances does everyone have the right to security?
candidates.answer_in_source: Disability, widowhood, old age or other lack of livelihood in circumstances beyond his control.

candidates.question: By what means must the limitations on the exercise of rights and freedoms be determined?
Besides his rights and obligations, what else may be determined at the fair and public hearing?
What penalty may not be exceeded for a penal offence?
candidates.answer_in_source: The one that was applicable at the time the penal offence was committed.

candidates.question: How many grounds are listed that may not limit the right to marry and to found a family?
Under what condition is depriving a person of his property forbidden?
How many kinds of rights are described as indispensable for his dignity?
What is the last right listed in the first sentence?
